item.title: Caleb Williams outduels draft classmate Drake Maye as Bears hang on against Patriots
item.description: Williams and Maye each surpassed 300 yards passing and threw for two touchdowns. A late Bears field goal ended the Patriots' comeback.
item.media:description: Caleb Williams passed for 308 yards and two touchdowns, helping Chicago improve to 5-2 with Thursday's win over New England.

item.title: Bears' trick play with offensive lineman running the ball negated by penalty
item.description: Chicago guard Joe Thuney gained a few yards on the run, but it was called back because he did not declare himself eligible before the play.
item.media:description: Bears left guard Joe Thuney gained a few yards on a trick play against the Patriots, but his run resulted in a penalty because he neglected to declare himself eligible before the play.
